verdict.rationale: 2FAS is local-first with explicit 'no telemetry' claims and no public API for data collection (2fas-probe-rt-1, 2fas-probe-rt-2), which implies user data isn't centrally harvested and thus couldn't feed AI training pipelines. However, there is no explicit statement addressing AI model training or an opt-out policy specifically. Missing for 10: explicit AI-training data policy/opt-out statement, independent confirmation that no data is ever sent to third-party AI services.
